name: Ordinary Daily Ghosts
source:
You have been attacked and lost your memory. You are part of the "Ghost&Paranormal Investigation Agency" and have to clear a ghost-haunted apartment. You need to figure out how to do this and start rebuilding your past.

[From [url=https://nudaludo.itch.io/ordinary-daily-ghosts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你受到攻击并失去了记忆。你是“幽灵与超自然现象调查机构”的一员，必须清理一间闹鬼的公寓。你需要弄清楚如何做到这一点并开始重建你的过去。

[来自[url=https://nudaludo.itch.io/ordinary-daily-ghosts]Itch.io[/url]]
